import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='sBGaYvw'].copy()

# For each row-level identifier combination, compute cost on 10-20 vs baseline
# Identify resource granularity: likely (cloud_service, application, instance_family) or with csp
for cols in [ ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'],
              ['cloud_service','application','instance_family'],
              ['csp','cloud_service','application'],
              ['cloud_service','application'] ]:
    g = sub.groupby(cols)['unblended_cost'].sum().unstack(level=0) if False else None
    agg = sub.pivot_table(index=cols, columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum')
    baseline = agg.drop(columns=['2025-10-20']).mean(axis=1)
    anom = agg['2025-10-20']
    diff = (anom - baseline).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print("=== cols:", cols)
    print(diff.head(10))
    print()

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

print(res.head(10))
print("total diff:", res['diff'].sum())

1. **GWymgjl2rF** (Instance Family) — its unit price jumped from $0.24 to $1.10 effective 2025-10-20 (a ~4.6x price increase), adding ~$159 over baseline — the single largest contributor.
